svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A machine shop part. The tube is 42 mm bar, 260 mm long, bored and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: honed to 22 mm H8 right through; the flange and funnel collar may be

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: turned from 100 mm bar and welded on, then the bore finish-honed.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Flange 100 mm across, 10 mm thick, at the top of the tube; four 8.5 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: holes on an 82 mm circle at 45 degrees to the front.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Funnel 64 mm across, 12 mm above the flange; cone from 56 to 22 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lower end: M30 x 1.5 thread, 15 mm deep, for the nozzle; face square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Thermocouple well: 3.2 mm, 8 mm deep, on the left side, 120 mm above

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the lower end, between the two band heaters.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the flange sits on four mica pads on the shelf, held by four M8

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: cap screws; the tube passes the shelf hole with 2 mm all round.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the plunger slides through the whole bore by hand, cold.
